## Hot Ones Episode Data {.unnumbered}


### Description

Episode-level data from the YouTube show Hot Ones, including
guest names, titles, and YouTube engagement metrics.



### Usage

<pre><code class='language-R'>hotones_episodes
</code></pre>


### Format

A tibble with variables:


<dl>
<dt>season</dt><dd>Season of Hot Ones
</dd>
<dt>order</dt><dd>Episode number within season
</dd>
<dt>guest</dt><dd>Name of the guest
</dd>
<dt>episode_title</dt><dd>Full title of the episode
</dd>
<dt>publish_date</dt><dd>Date the episode was published on YouTube
</dd>
<dt>views</dt><dd>Number of YouTube views (in millions)
</dd>
<dt>likes</dt><dd>Number of YouTube likes
</dd>
<dt>comments</dt><dd>Number of YouTube comments
</dd>
<dt>short_description</dt><dd>Short description of the episode
</dd>
<dt>img</dt><dd>URL to episode thumbnail image
</dd>
<dt>video_id</dt><dd>YouTube video ID
</dd>
</dl>



### Source

Hot Ones / First We Feast (YouTube)
